scope: Layer-level check of the registered candidate inventories and source metadata before registration. Read: file lists, geometry types, feature counts, bounding boxes, CRS, attribute field names, ArcGIS metadata text, catchment-id linkage. Not read: any terrain value, per-landslide statistic of Iburi or Wenchuan beyond counts, any model output. No new file was downloaded.

iburi_2018.record: https://zenodo.org/api/records/2577300 (licence cc-by-4.0, published 2019-02-25, creators Zhang, Li, Wang, Iio, Shimane University; no paper DOI in the record)
iburi_2018.record_description_summary: detailed landslide inventory, old landslide inventory incl. reactivated area, three standard-deviation ellipses, four AMeDAS stations in the vicinity of the study area

landslide_inventory/landslide_inventory..fields_note: Join_Count, area, perimeter, ID, geology join fields (legend_en, age_en, litho_en), LSA; no date, no type, no source-area field

Standard Deviational Ellipse/ellipse_1...note: centre 579710 E / 4735736 N, X/Y standard distances 1, 2 and 3 SD of the landslide distribution (ellipse_3 areakm 1557); a statistic of the landslides, not a mapping extent

gsi_d1_no991.finding: slope-failure/deposit map interpreted from GSI aerial photos of 6-11 Sep 2018; GeoJSON ZIP 1.1 MB (D1-No.991); the page does not describe an interpretation extent and does not publish photo coverage as data; terms: GSI content terms of use with attribution
gsi_d1_no991.status: not downloaded; archive content to be checked in Phase 1

alternatives_checked.literature_areas: published affected-area figures differ (about 400, 440, 580, >700 km2) because each study draws its own boundary; none is a published file

gorkha_2015.mapping_extent: available (MappingExtent20170209.shp, 1 polygon, 28,345 km2; ObscuredAreas20170209.shp, 456 polygons; v01 PHASE1_GATE.md)

rer2023.record: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.13742643: only RER2023_V1.rar -> RER2023_V1.shp (v01 phase1_audit_rer2023.json, no other files)
rer2023.article: https://essd.copernicus.org/articles/17/1055/2025/ : area 'segmented based on the administrative boundaries of the municipalities', 'more than 6000 km2', affected zone described as the southern sector from Rimini to Reggio Emilia; no municipality list, no extent file in the data availability statement
rer2023.regional_layers: INSPIRE record of Regione Emilia-Romagna on areas under safeguard measures after the May 2023 landslides (created 2023-06-01, updated 2024-03-18): derived from the landslides, not a mapping extent
rer2023.contact_for_extent: corresponding author Alessandro Corsini (University of Modena and Reggio Emilia); alternatively Regione Emilia-Romagna, Settore Difesa del Territorio

wenchuan_fan2019.finding: the 252 catchments are the debris-flow catchments of Dataset 2; none matches the integer CIDs of the multi-temporal landslide layers; 65 catchments (575 km2) intersect the 2008 bounding box versus 42 catchments / 471 km2 in the article. The 42 mapped catchments are not published as an extent; choosing them by overlap with landslides would derive the extent from the polygons.

conclusion: Neither trigger can currently be staffed with two inventories that have an independent mapping extent: earthquake = Gorkha only, rain = Far-Western Nepal only. v02 is registered with Iburi and RER2023 as pending_extent; Phase 1 cannot start until an extent is obtained for at least one of them.
